title: Spatial domain selection and regional expression consistency in colorectal cancer Visium data
description: This release improves the graph-comparison figure layout and supplements field definitions. Scientific code and inputs for regional expression comparisons in 22 colorectal cancer Visium sections. This release corrects filtered-matrix extraction and includes refitted domain maps and sensitivity comparisons with archived primary maps. It provides separate saved-map and original-count fitting workflows. The historical fitting environment was not completely version locked; domain refits can differ. Complete 840-configuration partition comparisons and patient-level aggregation from saved map results were checked; sampling-reference scripts were exercised on one section from each resource. A complete uninterrupted original-input execution through all figures and tables has not been verified. Third-party data and software retain their source terms.
